season.evidence: Mountaineers glacier trips run late June through late August; mountain-forecast lists May-Sep; stored Jul-Sep with late June in best_season; ascents peak July.

track.why: Our catalog holds exactly one route on this peak, and this 9 Jun 2024 track follows its described line: Pyramid Lake trailhead, Pyramid Ridge, the glacier basin to the summit (6 m from our pin) and back to the lot (34 m start, 81 m end).

otherTracksConsidered.why: 8 Jun 2024 same line but includes an attempt on a neighbouring peak; kept 2535939 for the cleaner summit track.
5 Oct 2024 same line, round trip, no report; within a month of the season edge, but snow and glacier travel in October.
Starts from high camp, partial track.

facts.text: In early June snow begins near 4,800 ft and is continuous above 5,200 ft; wet, unconsolidated and knee-deep postholing in the heat.
Cornices released onto the ridge path beneath Pyramid and Pinnacle in early June; cross the exposed section early before the sun softens it.
The steepest snow of the day, about 60 degrees near 7,500 ft, takes kick-stepping in early June.
In mid-July the ridge from the saddle beside Neve ends at a gendarme with steep drops on both sides; use the snowfield below the notch instead.

In late August the snow near Colonial Lake has melted; follow the northwest ridge past tarns, then the snow finger and a short class-2 notch to the north face, where the upper snowfield has a bad runout.

notes: Single route on the peak, so identity rests on the line. The stored route text says there is no public GPS track.
